scenes.label: ask_opus
scenes.description: Open mid-click on the broken app and Opus, with the first reply already approaching.

scenes.label: limit_opus
scenes.description: Opus allowance drains and the limit card makes the first obstacle visible.

scenes.label: ask_astra
scenes.description: The active tab and assistant window switch to Astra.

scenes.label: limit_astra
scenes.description: Astra gets a tomorrow reset label and an empty allowance.

scenes.label: ask_gemini
scenes.description: Switch immediately to Gemini as the third attempted escape.

scenes.label: limit_gemini
scenes.description: Gemini joins the exhausted allowances; the app is still broken.

scenes.label: clock
scenes.description: The date-and-time card opens and the digital clock jumps forward.

scenes.label: clock_reply
scenes.description: The reset is still tomorrow; Astra rejects the clock trick.

scenes.label: trial
scenes.description: A new email address types into a free-trial form.

scenes.label: recognize
scenes.description: The submit action becomes a welcome-back card with Alex recognized.

scenes.label: upgrade
scenes.description: Three assistant subscriptions fan out; each payment lands with a click and cash cue.

scenes.label: paid
scenes.description: Green active states restore the allowances briefly.

scenes.anchor: Compare the plans. Find the best one.
scenes.label: compare
scenes.description: The subscriptions become a plan-comparison table while the restored allowance drains.

scenes.anchor: You've used your new allowance comparing the plans.
scenes.label: limit_again
scenes.description: The new allowance is exhausted on the comparison; all three limits return.

scenes.anchor: I've managed three subscriptions, six reset timers, and five billing dashboards. That's my entire morning.
scenes.label: inventory
scenes.description: Three subscriptions, six reset timers and five billing dashboards assemble on their spoken numbers.

scenes.label: app_check
scenes.description: The dashboard stack clears to reveal the unchanged broken app.

scenes.label: broken
scenes.description: Alex facepalms while the error remains readable.

scenes.anchor: What do you put on your CV?
scenes.label: cv_question
scenes.description: A CV sheet grows from the dashboard stack and Alex becomes its profile photo.

scenes.label: cv_title
scenes.description: Full-stack developer appears on speech, morphs to Full-stack subscriber, then Alex gives one small reluctant nod.
